2025-06-30.riddle: I light your path when roads are dark, I beam ahead like a glowing spark. I’m mounted to cars to help you see— What am I?

2025-07-01.riddle: I click and scroll and help you surf, I glide across a desktop turf. With buttons small, I lead the way— What am I?
2025-07-01.hint: I’m not a rodent, but I live near your keyboard.

2025-07-02.riddle: I flash when there’s a snap to take, I capture moments you won’t fake. With focus tight, I frame your smile— What am I?
2025-07-02.hint: I freeze time with a click.

2025-07-03.riddle: I go up high, yet I don’t fly, You ride me when you reach the sky. I carry weight with pulleys tight— What am I?
2025-07-03.hint: I lift you in a box of light.

2025-07-04.riddle: I sparkle bright, I roar and crack, I paint the sky, then fade right back. I’m loud on nights of celebration— What am I?
2025-07-04.hint: You hear me boom on the Fourth of July.

2025-07-05.riddle: I’m smooth and flat, I glide with ease, Across the waves and salty breeze. You stand on me to catch a ride— What am I?
2025-07-05.hint: I ride the ocean under your feet.

2025-07-06.riddle: I’m full of wind but have no lungs, I flap and wave when I’m among. With stars or stripes or symbols bold— What am I?
2025-07-06.hint: I stand for something on a pole.

2025-07-07.riddle: I zip and store, I carry tight, From pencils dull to pens that write. You take me to your desk or class— What am I?
2025-07-07.hint: I’m a little bag for all your stuff.
